target: Mathematical novelty of the Huddling / diatonic-pentatonic Fourier-energy note and connections to earlier music-math notes

verdict.new_mathematical_theorem: Not established. The central results are known, and the proposed connections are classical identities or consequences of known characterizations.
verdict.new_formalization: No matching proof-assistant development was located in the bounded formalization audit. This supports a contribution in formalization, not a universal first-formalization claim.
verdict.appropriate_paper_claim: A connected Lean 4 formalization of classical twelve-tone extremality, with explicit equality classes, exact arithmetic, reusable bridges, and reproducible independent checks.
inappropriate_claims: general roots-of-unity theorem proved by a twelve-tone census

statement_comparison.statement: Consecutive roots maximize the magnitude of the sum at fixed cardinality, uniquely up to rotation
statement_comparison.status: Known theorem, specialized here to ZMod 12
statement_comparison.location: Amiot, 2006 preprint, Theorem 7 and its strict improvement proof, PDF page 6

statement_comparison.statement: Unit multiplication permutes Fourier indices; a coprime-cardinality maximum is the inverse image of a consecutive cluster
statement_comparison.status: Classical reindexing identity and known generated-scale characterization
statement_comparison.location: Amiot 2006, Lemma 2 and Theorem 8, PDF pages 6-7
statement_comparison.qualification: The maximum at arbitrary unit frequency is an inverse-image cluster. It must not be called maximally even at every arbitrary frequency/cardinality.

statement_comparison.statement: The diatonic seven-note collection maximizes frequency-five magnitude and is an all-pairs convex-energy minimizer
statement_comparison.status: Two classical characterizations of the same maximally even orbit
statement_comparison.location: Amiot 2007; Douthett-Krantz 2007; Bushaw-Cody-Leffler 2025 version, Theorem 2.16, PDF page 10
statement_comparison.qualification: The recent paper uses unordered pairs and geodesic distance, matching this development's convention. Earlier formulations may use ordered pairs and clockwise distances.

statement_comparison.statement: For strict decreasing convex potentials, Fourier extremality is equivalent to energy extremality at seven-of-twelve
statement_comparison.status: Immediate corollary of the two known equality-class characterizations
statement_comparison.qualification: An explicit joined Lean declaration is useful, but joining known equivalences does not establish mathematical novelty.

statement_comparison.statement: Complementary sets have opposite nonzero Fourier coefficients; complementary extremal collections are diatonic and pentatonic
statement_comparison.status: Known identity and known maximal-evenness complement theorem
statement_comparison.location: Amiot 2006, Theorems 2 and 6, PDF pages 3 and 5
statement_comparison.older_attribution: Clough-Douthett 1991, Theorem 3.3, explicitly attributed in Bushaw-Cody-Leffler Theorem 3.1

statement_comparison.statement: Complementation changes all-pairs energy by a cardinality-dependent constant, preserving the energy ordering within a cardinality
statement_comparison.status: Special case of a stronger published graph theorem
statement_comparison.location: Bushaw, Cody, Leffler, Theorem 3.5, equation (3.1), PDF page 13
statement_comparison.qualification: Their distance-degree-regular graph result includes C12 and does not require convexity for the complement energy identity.

statement_comparison.statement: Homometric sets have equal energy for every distance potential; the diatonic homometry class contains only transpositions
statement_comparison.status: Direct consequences of classical homometry and extremal uniqueness, not claimed as new mathematics
statement_comparison.location: Amiot-Sethares 2009, section 4.2.2 (equivalent descriptions of homometry); Amiot's Fourier equality-class characterization
statement_comparison.qualification: We did not locate the exact combined corollary under this wording; mathematical novelty does not follow from absence of that wording.

statement_comparison.statement: M5 preserves coefficient six and commutes with transposition six
statement_comparison.status: Elementary consequences of unit reindexing and 5*6 = 6 modulo 12
statement_comparison.qualification: Useful links to the parity and tritone notes; no novelty claim is attached to these algebraic identities.

recent_related_work.title: Sets of vertices with extremal energy
recent_related_work.scope: Full primary-source PDF, relevant theorems and conventions inspected
recent_related_work.implication: The proposed complement-energy bridge is already covered in greater mathematical generality.

recent_related_work.title: The Music and Mathematics of Maximal Evenness in Graphs
recent_related_work.scope: Primary-source PDF inspected for graph/energy context
recent_related_work.implication: Graph generalization is an existing mathematical research direction; any new formalization must cite it.

recent_related_work.author: Emmanuel Amiot
recent_related_work.title: A novel characterization of ME sets
recent_related_work.scope: Publisher-indexed title and abstract found; full text could not be retrieved
recent_related_work.implication: IFunc/generated-set characterizations remain active in 2026. Any candidate based on that characterization needs full-text review before a novelty claim. No theorem in the current note is attributed to this inaccessible full text.

limitations: This is a targeted literature audit, not an exhaustive systematic review of every book, dissertation, language, or unpublished manuscript.
A negative search cannot prove global absence. Positive antecedents are enough to exclude mathematical novelty for the central proposed results.
Mathematical theorem novelty and proof-assistant implementation novelty are distinct questions.
No claim about novelty of corpus-level duration-weighted empirical findings is made by this finite-set audit.
